title: Blood-Burning Moon
focus: love and rivalry destroyed by racial violence

teacherSummary.text: Louisa, a Black woman in a Georgia factory town, is loved by Tom Burwell, a Black field worker, and Bob Stone, the son of the white family she works for. Under a full moon that the women read as an omen, Bob confronts Tom and is killed by Tom's knife. A white mob lynches Tom, burning him at the old factory. Louisa, unaware, sings to the moon.
